issues: src/pages/Training.tsx: The file contains a syntax error – it uses a plain import statement which is invalid in Python execution context; the test crashes with "TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'useEffect')" indicating the component fails to render. Ensure the component correctly imports and uses React (remove the stray "React." prefix in useEffect) and that it exports a functional component without errors.

Header contains duplicate navigation links leading to multiple elements matching the same name, causing tests to find multiple "Services" links and duplicate "Book a consultation" links. Adjust the Header to render each nav link only once and ensure the Book a consultation button is a <button> or <a> with unique role, not duplicated elsewhere on the page.

Contact page does not render the email address "hello@thebayesgroup.com" as plain text, causing the test to fail. Add the email element (e.g.,

hello@thebayesgroup.com

) to the Contact component.

Home page hero CTA buttons are both rendered as links with the same accessible name "Book a consultation", leading to multiple matching elements. Change the hero's second CTA to a distinct element (e.g., a button labeled "Explore services") or give it a unique accessible name.

Home page "How we work" steps are rendered as list items with bold tags that split the text, making the plain text "Assess" not directly searchable. Ensure each step text is present as a plain string matching the test expectation (e.g., list item content exactly "Assess – We evaluate..." without extra markup that splits the word).

Home page "Why The Bayes Group" points contain hyphenated text "Vendor‑neutral advice" which the test expects as "vendor-neutral advice" (case-insensitive). Ensure the text matches the regex used in the test (e.g., "Vendor neutral advice" or include a space/hyphen as needed).
About page company values list does not match the regex for "Vendor neutral" due to hyphenation or spacing; adjust the wording to satisfy /Vendor[-\s]neutral/.

NotFound page link back to home does not contain the word "home" in its text, causing the test to expect "home" but find "The Bayes Group". Update the link text to include the word "home" (e.g., <Link to="/">Go to home page</Link>).

Footer test throws ReferenceError: within is not defined, likely due to missing import of within from '@testing-library/react' in the test file. No code change needed; however, the test environment may need the within function. If required, ensure the test imports within correctly.
feedback: Multiple acceptance tests are failing due to duplicated elements, missing email text, syntax errors in Training component, and slight mismatches in wording. Fix the component implementations as described to satisfy the tests.
